newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila airport seizes smuggled Piranhas.
newsitem.headline: Manila airport seizes smuggled Piranhas.

text.p: Authorities at Manila's international airport found 2,200 Piranha fingerlings hidden in cases containing tropical fish on Saturday, an official said.

Fisheries Quarantine Service chief Felipe Santamaria said the Piranhas were smuggled in a shipment of tropical fish from Hong Kong. They were found in false compartments in the bottom of the containers.

Piranhas are abundant in South America with a reputation for ferocity despite their small size. Attracted by the scent of blood, they attack in groups, and can strip a large mammal of its flesh within minutes.
Santamaria said the Piranhas would be killed to prevent accidental release into local rivers.
